visual.description: Pure black used as the main page background throughout the site.
White used for primary headings and high-contrast text elements.
Bright neon lime green used for call-to-action buttons, brand accents, and positive indicators.
Light gray used for body copy and secondary text content.
Medium gray used for de-emphasized text and tertiary content.
Very dark gray used for card backgrounds and elevated surface elements.
Medium-dark gray used for secondary buttons like 'Contact us'.
Bright red used for live status badges and real-time indicators.
Sky blue used as part of gradient backgrounds on feature cards.
Soft pink used as part of gradient backgrounds on feature cards.
Warm gold used in gradient backgrounds for section highlights.
Coral used as part of gradient backgrounds on data visualization cards.
Mint green used as part of gradient backgrounds on data visualization cards.
Purple used in the aurora-style gradient effect in hero backgrounds.
Teal used in the aurora-style gradient effect in hero backgrounds.
